title: Preserve control-plane disclosure state across sync refreshes
specification:
# PRD: Preserve control-plane disclosure state across sync refreshes

Priority: high

## Problem
Frontend disclosure sections such as "Repo status and details", "Work coordination details", and "Operational diagnostics and controls" close automatically whenever the control-plane UI refreshes after a sync because the repo card DOM is re-rendered and `<details>` state is not preserved.

## Goal
Keep disclosure panels in their current open or closed state across dashboard/project sync refreshes so operators can inspect status while live updates continue.

## Requirements
- Preserve `RepoDisclosure` open/closed state across `refresh()`-driven re-renders in both manager and project views.
- Key persisted state by stable repo/view/disclosure identity so multiple repo cards do not conflict.
- Do not force all disclosures open globally; restore the user's last state for each disclosure.
- Keep current rendering behavior for disclosure contents while avoiding autoclose on normal sync updates.
- Add focused unit coverage for disclosure state persistence during repeated renders or refreshes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- If a manager opens "Repo status and details" and a sync refresh occurs, the section remains open.
- If a project user opens "Work coordination details" or "Operational diagnostics and controls" and a sync refresh occurs, the section remains open.
- Closed disclosures remain closed after refresh.
- Disclosure state is isolated per repo/view and does not leak between cards.
- Automated tests fail without the persistence behavior and pass with it.

## Verification
- Add a unit test that renders a repo card, marks a disclosure open, re-renders with updated repo data, and verifies the disclosure remains open.
- Add a project-view test covering both "Work coordination details" and "Operational diagnostics and controls" across refresh.
- Manual browser verification: open each affected disclosure, trigger a sync/refresh, confirm state is preserved.

tasks.description: Update the control-plane UI so `RepoDisclosure` open and closed state survives `refresh()`-driven re-renders in both manager and project views by restoring state from a stable disclosure identity. Scope includes the disclosure component and the manager/project repo-card rendering paths under `src/server/control-plane/`, plus any local state helpers needed to key persistence by repo, view, and disclosure identity without changing disclosure content rendering or backend sync behavior.
acceptance: Manager-view repo cards preserve the user's last open or closed state for the "Repo status and details" disclosure after a sync or `refresh()` causes the card to re-render.

Project-view repo cards preserve the user's last open or closed state for the "Work coordination details" and "Operational diagnostics and controls" disclosures after a sync or `refresh()` causes the card to re-render.

Disclosure persistence is keyed by stable repo, view, and disclosure identity so opening or closing a disclosure on one repo card does not affect the same disclosure on another repo card or in another view.
Closed disclosures remain closed across repeated refreshes, and the change does not globally force disclosures open or otherwise alter existing disclosure content rendering.

Focused unit coverage is added for a manager-view refresh case and a project-view refresh case that re-render updated repo data and assert disclosure state persistence, including at least one isolation assertion showing state does not leak between repo cards.
Verification includes `npm run typecheck` and the relevant control-plane unit tests covering repo-card or disclosure refresh behavior.
